title: Rebuild home landing with Zara-inspired editorial layout
body: ## Summary This change rebuilds the `/` landing experience to follow a Zara-like storefront pattern: stark black-on-white chrome, a centered wordmark, full-bleed hero, editorial two-up strip, horizontal category filters, and a tight product grid with minimal typography. Home-specific styling is scoped under `layout--home-zara` so album and detail pages keep the existing warm palette. ## Walkthrough Centered header, hero, filters, and grid after the header layout tweak. ![Centered LOOKBOOK header](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-96314410-b613-4778-a46b-3768866a798d) ![Filters and product grid](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-4e669713-ce90-4e58-80b1-76796af4d6dc) ## Testing - `npm run build` - Manual browser check at `http://127.0.0.1:5173/` (hero, filters, grid, filter interaction)
